title: Privacy Coins Defy Crash, Surge 13% Amid Market-Wide Liquidations
summary: Privacy-focused cryptocurrencies climbed 13% over the past week while Bitcoin and altcoins tumbled, with Monero hitting new highs and DUSK surging 354% as investors rotate toward censorship-resistant assets following Tether's mass wallet freezes and escalating regulatory pressures.The postPrivacy Coins Defy Crash, Surge 13% Amid Market-Wide Liquidationsappeared first onCryptonews.

title: Privacy Coins Monero, Dash and Dusk Defy Crypto Market Slump
summary: The privacy coin category posted gains amid a broad market sell-off, as experts cite growing demand for "defensive" assets.
